Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single production-oriented character concept/reference sheet for three ORIGINAL selectable characters in a Hebrew/English children's learning adventure, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. This is one cohesive reference sheet, not a screenshot and not app UI.
Reference image 1 (existing puppy art) is only a STYLE/COMPLEXITY reference: approachable 2D shapes, soft painterly gradients, dark expressive eyes and gentle contour, readable as a small game sprite. Do NOT copy the puppy's anatomy or rainbow eyes. Reference image 2 (current map) is a WORLD PALETTE reference: moss, warm lantern light, storybook foliage. Make a natural bridge from these existing assets to a richer forest adventure. Original personalities, no existing franchise character shapes, no glowing white long-eared hero, no owl, no existing blue water monster.
Layout: three clean equal-width columns on matte warm ivory background with plenty of breathing room, no borders or lettering. Each column has one large full-body three-quarter neutral friendly pose at top, and underneath two smaller studies: a full-body side view and a close-up of one distinctive expression. Maintain precisely consistent anatomy and markings within each column. All three have short limbs and simple expressive faces; not glossy plastic toys, not photoreal fur or detailed scales, no clothing or props.
LEFT / NABAT / נבט: a small pear-shaped moss-green woodland creature with two broad rounded LEAF-shaped ears growing sideways and upward, simple central leaf vein. Warm cream face and tummy, little rootlike feet, tiny rounded hands. Subtle soft moss texture just on top/back, clean overall silhouette. Kind dark oval eyes with a single warm catchlight. Curious listener, attentive slight head tilt. Leaf ears never become thin rabbit ears. Expression study: listening with one leaf ear tipped forward.
MIDDLE / ADVA / אדוה: a small squat slate-blue river creature with a pale blue-gray belly and two compact SCALLOPED fan-shaped SIDE FINS at cheek height. Wide rounded head, small round hands, two broad short feet, no tail, no horns or head fin. Three rounded scallops on each cheek fin, visually distinctive from Nabat. Dark expressive eyes and little smile. Playful energy. Expression study: delighted surprised laugh, fins lifted slightly. Muted river blue, not electric saturated cyan.
RIGHT / ZOHAR / זוהר: a small upright round ochre woodland creature, slightly narrower and taller than Adva, with two little rounded side ears, warm amber oval belly patch, and exactly THREE small pale-gold dots arranged in a little triangle on that belly patch. Short arms and sturdy tiny feet; no tail, wings, cape, leaf crown or flame head. Thoughtful eyes, friendly mild smile. Matte ochre surface, softly luminous belly spots only, very restrained. Expression study: thoughtful questioning look and a small reassuring smile.
Lighting: consistent soft diffuse daylight with warm bounce, subtle grounding shadows beneath feet. Colors earthy green, slate blue, honey ochre, ivory. Charming for ages 4-7 with visual sophistication and clear silhouettes. Reference-sheet clarity over busy decoration. No written text, labels, fake writing, watermark, ornamental frames or extra cast.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one landscape 16:9 START KEYFRAME for a planned six-second AI-generated wordless video in a children's language-learning adventure.
Reference 1 is the NEW CHARACTER IDENTITY SHEET. Use ONLY the ochre character in the RIGHT column, Zohar. Preserve its exact round ears, cream muzzle, warm brown oval eyes, ochre fur silhouette, short hands and feet, and amber oval belly with THREE pale golden dots in a triangle. This same character must be recognizable as a playable 2D game character. Do not include the green or blue heroes in this close shot.
Reference 2 is ATMOSPHERE ONLY: the waterfall garden, warm moss and foliage, soft natural light. Do not copy its blob characters or glowing fairy. Bring the environment closer to soft hand-painted storybook game art, not a photographic CGI forest.
Scene: On a wide safe mossy bank beside a quiet shallow forest stream, Zohar stands on the LEFT, thoughtfully offering a small simple woven basket toward ONE recurring river resident on the RIGHT. The recipient is a new small plump olive-green frog-like woodland creature with smooth rounded body, a pale cream throat, short round hands and feet, two gentle dark eyes, no leaf ears, no antennae, no clothes or accessories. Slightly smaller than Zohar. The resident's hopeful face is beginning to brighten as it recognizes what Zohar brought. Its hands are just beginning to reach toward the basket, not yet touching. The basket contains two clearly identifiable red apples and a small closed blue water flask. Items are learning props, no lettering.
Composition: medium-wide eye-level two-shot, both full bodies visible, characters occupy central 65% of image width and about half its height, basket perfectly readable in center between them. Zohar's belly marking still visible, arms not hiding whole torso. Mossy stepping stones beneath both, stream in background, distant soft silver waterfall hinted at through leaves. Soft layered forest framing, warm amber late-afternoon light and muted moss greens, subtle darker forest beyond for depth, no threat. One tiny warm root-light on the ground behind them anticipates magic but does not distract. Child senses 'I understand what you need, and I can help.'
This is a clean compositional start frame for simple animation: no camera motion blur, no jumping, no action lines, no confetti or complex particles. Illustration finish consistent with reference 1, rounded expressive faces, tasteful soft contours, watercolor/gouache texture, sophisticated warm cinematic light but no glossy 3D toy material. No text, captions, UI, symbols, speech bubbles, owl, bird mount, fairy, extra cast, watermark or panels.
